question: An Enterprise owner decides to shorten the organisation's data retention period substantially. What is the greatest concern before saving the change?
options: A) Shortening retention disables project sharing, because shared projects require indefinite retention.
B) Data falling outside the new window is deleted immediately, so work still in progress can be lost.
C) The change applies only to new chats, so nothing older is affected and the setting has no real effect.
D) Every connector must be re-authenticated by each member before the shorter window can take effect.
correct_answers: B) Data falling outside the new window is deleted immediately, so work still in progress can be lost.
explanations: Retention settings and project sharing are unrelated.
Correct. Shortening retention deletes anything already older than the new window as soon as it is saved.
The setting is not limited to new conversations; existing data is in scope.
Retention changes do not require connectors to be reconnected.
